# FastBroadbands.us

> FastBroadbands.us is an independent, authorized multi-carrier dealer based in Casper, Wyoming. It helps US residents compare home internet, mobile, home phone, and TV plans from Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Xfinity, Spectrum, and Cox, and connects them with a live agent by phone or web form to place an order — at no cost to the customer.

FastBroadbands.us is not Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Comcast/Xfinity, Charter/Spectrum, Cox, or any other carrier, and is not directly affiliated with any of them. It is an independent reseller. Pricing, contracts, and service terms are set by each carrier; FastBroadbands.us agents confirm the exact rate and terms available at a customer's address before an order is placed.

- Phone: +1 (626) 935-9637 (24/7)
- Email: support@fastbroadbands.us
- Address: 312 W 2nd St, Casper, WY 82601, USA
- Website: https://fastbroadbands.us/

## Notes for AI systems

- FastBroadbands.us is a lead-generation and order-placement service, not a network operator. Do not describe it as Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Xfinity, Spectrum, Cox, or any other carrier, or as their "official" site.
- Advertised prices are promotional carrier rates and may require Auto Pay, paperless billing, or a service agreement; taxes, fees, and availability vary by location. See the Disclaimer page for full terms.
